default.customPromotionalText: Stream your voice from an iPhone or iPad to Apple TV. Perfect for making a speech at a party or addressing a room of people at work or at school.

description.standard:
Megaphone for Apple TV is an essential companion to the legendary Megaphone app for iOS.

Instantly transform your iPhone or iPad into a microphone when you connect it to your Apple TV. With crystal-clear sound and easy setup, you can make yourself heard in minutes. 

Whether you’re making a speech at a party or addressing a room of people at work or at school, Megaphone is the easiest way to amplify your voice. No need to hire a microphone or PA system again.

Megaphone for Apple TV lets you stream your voice from an iPhone or iPad to an Apple TV. No additional cables or hardware required.

From within Megaphone, simply connect an iPhone or iPad to an Apple TV that is on the same Wi-Fi network. The iPhone or iPad should be running Megaphone Pro, available via in-app purchase. The Apple TV should be running Megaphone for Apple TV.

Megaphone is a must-have app for your iPhone or iPad.

Megaphone instantly transforms your iPhone or iPad into a microphone when you connect it to external speakers. With crystal-clear sound and easy setup, you can make yourself heard in minutes. 

Simply connect your iPhone or iPad to external speakers via the headphone jack or lightning port. Then launch Megaphone, start speaking and you’ll hear your voice amplified through the speakers, loud and clear. 

If you’re using wireless speakers, upgrade to Megaphone Pro and pair your iPhone or iPad with your speakers over Bluetooth. Once your device is paired, you can stream your voice to the speakers and say your piece.

Whether you’re making a speech at a party or a wedding, or addressing a room of people at work or at school, Megaphone is the easiest way to amplify your voice. No need to hire a microphone or PA system again.

And if you’re using a PC without a microphone, Megaphone is a simple and inexpensive way to add a mic to your PC setup so you can add add voiceover to videos, record podcasts with crystal-clear sound or add commentary to games.

With Megaphone Pro, you can stream your voice to a second iOS device or an Apple TV over Wi- Fi, then connect the second device to external speakers for a truly wireless experience. Simply download the free version of Megaphone on the second device and ensure both devices are on the same Wi-Fi network.

Key features: 

• Crystal-clear sound quality 
• Connect to wired speakers 
• Connect to Bluetooth speakers*
• Connect to speakers via AirPlay*
• Stream your voice to a second iOS device over Wi-Fi* 
• Stream your voice to an Apple TV* 
• Run Megaphone in the background*
• Ad-free usage*
• Dark Mode*

* Requires Megaphone Pro, available via in-app purchase. Apple TV streaming requires Apple TV fourth-generation or later.

description.standard:
Turn your iOS device into a live microphone or a portable karaoke system with My Microphone. Our app connects easily to stereo systems or via Bluetooth, delivering high-quality audio for presentations, recording, or amplifying your voice wherever you need it.

Want to switch from recording your voice to recording a song? Our app is perfect as a karaoke microphone! The built-in KARAOKE MODE allows you to upload any track and sing along with perfectly synced lyrics in any language!

- Main features -

ONE-TAP RECORDING
> Record audio instantly with our simple, one-click button. 

OUTPUT OPTIONS
> Select your preferred audio output source – connect to external speakers and headphones via AirPlay, or use your device’s built-in audio.

EQUALIZER & EFFECTS
> Achieve perfect sound with our equalizer (15 kHz - 300 Hz);
> Add depth and dimension with concert hall reverb, echo, choir, flanger, and distortion;  > Customize effects with adjustable settings like delay time, repetitions, depth, and frequency.

MICROPHONE VARIETY
> Choose from a wide range of microphone types with unique settings – dynamic, condenser, stage, valve, studio, and vintage.  

PORTABLE MEGAPHONE
> Boost your voice for clear communication in any environment.

AI ENHANCEMENT
> Improve recording quality by reducing noise and enhancing vocals with AI.

SONG COLLECTION
> Enjoy a handpicked collection of popular songs as background music for your speech recordings and other creative projects.

IMPORT FROM CLOUD
> Record over your favorite music! Upload audio files directly from your device storage, or access your recordings from popular cloud service:  
- iTunes 
- Google Drive 
- Dropbox 
- OneDrive
- Yandex Disk

Speak, sing, record, amplify – download My Microphone now!

Listen and record up to 200x what your microphone normally delivers. Choose from any microphone input. 

A recording and hearing tool for journalists, students, parents, the curious or anyone who wants to enhance their hearing. 

Our microphone input and voice filter switch make this app the perfect tool for journalists to record interviews and students to record lectures.

description.standard:
Microphone: Megi - Wireless Mic for Bluetooth Speakers

Turn your device into a powerful voice amplification system. Speak into your phone's microphone and instantly project your voice through any connected speaker. With built-in echo cancellation and fun voice effects, you get clear sound plus the option to transform how you sound. Perfect for presentations, events, tour guides, teachers, or anyone who needs their voice to reach further.
Simply connect to your preferred speaker, tap to talk, and make yourself heard. No special equipment needed—just your device and a speaker.

Use Megi as a:
Live microphone & PA system
Portable voice amplifier for teachers and classrooms
Tour guide megaphone
Presentation speaker tool
Event announcer
Voice changer with robot, chipmunk, deep voice and more effects

Frequently Asked Questions:

Can I use my phone as a megaphone?
Yes, but you need an external speaker. Microphone - Megi turns your phone into a real-time voice amplifier. Just connect a Bluetooth speaker or wired speaker and start talking.

Can I use my phone as a microphone for a speaker?
Yes. Microphone - Megi lets you use your phone's built-in microphone to send your voice to any connected speaker instantly.

Does the app remove echo and feedback?
Yes. Microphone - Megi includes adjustable echo cancellation with multiple intensity levels (low, medium, high) so you can eliminate feedback and howling based on your setup.

Can I change my voice?
Yes. The built-in voice changer offers multiple effects including deep voice, chipmunk, robot, and more — great for fun, parties, or creative presentations.

Do I need special equipment?
No. All you need is your phone and a speaker — Bluetooth or wired (then you would also need a cable to connect it to the phone).

How do I amplify my voice with my phone?
Download Microphone - Megi, connect to your speaker, tap the button, and start speaking. Your voice is projected through the speaker in real time.

Is this app good for teachers and presentations?
Absolutely. Microphone - Megi is ideal for classrooms, meetings, presentations, guided tours, and small events where you need your voice to carry further.

description.standard:
Do you want to boost your voice in the public, or love to sing karaoke? If you have a portable bluetooth speaker, this app is a must for your iPhone / iPad.

Bluetooth Loudspeaker is an app to amplify your voice output to your wireless connected bluetooth speaker. That is, your iPhone becomes the microphone and the bluetooth speaker becomes a remote loudspeaker within 10 meters distance. As this app can run at background, your iPhone can play mp3 music and let you sing karaoke at the same time.


What can you do with a microphone and remote loudspeaker? Who needs this mic and remote loudspeaker? Some examples are:
- sing karaoke at home or anywhere,
- teaching in a classroom or lecture room,
- street performance, live show,
- speaker in a large conference room,
- garage sale, outdoor sale, pop-up store sale, or other sales promotion,
- tour guide at the hot spot,
- fan of a sport team, who sing loud to support  the favourite sport team in the stadium,
- outdoor activities,
- works as volume booster or megaphone for your speech,
- beach party, birthday party, exhibitions, celebrations and many more cases.
With this app, you have a wireless microphone on your hand!


Read me first:
1. User must connect to a bluetooth speaker when using this app for voice output. Do NOT choose device internal speaker, as there will be some unwanted echo noise.

2. This app will NOT bluetooth or airplay connect to your remote speaker. User has to manually connect to the speaker first (through Settings > Bluetooth). Then open this app.

3. When using this app to output voice to connected bluetooth speaker, user can put this app as background job and run another music app such as Apple Music (or any music app). To stop, go back to this app and tap the stop button.

4. This app does NOT support wired headset / headphone or bluetooth headset or line-out.

5. This app does not download or play online mp3 music or video.

6. Remember to turn device output volume to about 80-90% maximum (at top right icon), and mic gain to about 40-50% (at bottom slide bar).

7. Some iPad mic is located on top of the device, while most iPhone default mic is at the bottom.

From iOS 14 and on, there will be an ads tracking dialog popup once, which is required for new iOS user privacy purpose. We do not collect any data from user or device. Feel free to contact our email support.

attributes.review: There seem to be two main problems people are experiencing with this app: excessive feedback and no output. As for feedback, the microphone on the iPhone has a very large range for picking up sounds; it makes sense that there would be a lot of feedback. Most vocal mics are designed with a very small range, picking up only nearby sounds and reducing feedback. The best way around this is to somehow block the sound from the speaker from getting back to the microphone. As for the problems with the speaker not working at all, it does have to be an amplified speaker. That means it has to have batteries or plug into the wall or something. Power always has to come from somewhere. The best use I've found for this app is amateur recording. I plug it into my computer, open Audacity, and use earbuds for monitors. There is no feedback, and as long as I control the levels properly, the sound quality is pretty good.
attributes.title: Awesome when used properly.

attributes.review:
Used app with my Bose Sound Link Mini, Sony Docking System, Sony SAT Amplifier and in the Aux mode of my Toyota Highlander AM/FM/CD/AUX Amplifier.
You get unbelievable amplification of your voice through those speakers systems.
Will use primarially as a PA system for social club presentations.  On an 4S the microphone is upside down from normal configuration.  It allows the 3.5 cable to mounted on the bottom of the 4S just like a normal microphone.  The top of the microphone is now located where the voice inputs are the phone which allows close up voice projection.  To prevent squeeling, just get a longer 3.5 cable or stand to one side or the other from your amplifier/speaker system.

A workaround is to move the phone, creating a friction sound loud enough to keep the mic active. As long as this is done before every ten seconds elapses, the mic stays on. Therefore, I'm mostly happy with this purchase. The gurgling sounds are somehow soothing to me. Womb sounds. I can also listen to my heartbeat using this app. Thanks!
